subject: Orchestrating technical demo across time zones
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_l@redwood.ai>
To: Aliyah Thompson <aliyah@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + technical demo for Solstice Health

Hi Aliyah —

Thanks for signing up with Redwood Inference — really excited to connect. I work on SDR handoffs and will coordinate the demo with your team. To make sure we bring the right folks, can you confirm whether IT/security and a technical decision-maker will join? Our suggestion is a 45-minute + 15-minute buffer session so SE and AE can cover architecture and procurement/next steps.

Quick options (all PT):
- Tue Dec 1, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue Dec 1, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Wed Dec 2, 09:00–10:00 PT

If none of these work, tell me windows that overlap with your East Coast team and your IT/security folks and I’ll expand. I’ve CC’d Marcus (AE) to scope the agenda and Karthik (SE) will join the technical portion.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
SDR, Redwood Inference
[jasmine_l@redwood.ai]

Attachments: proposed-times.ics (calendar poll stub)
From: Aliyah Thompson <aliyah@solsticehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_l@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@solsticehealth.com>, IT Security Team <security@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro + technical demo for Solstice Health

Thanks, Jasmine —

Appreciate the options. Quick context: our team is split across ET (clinical ops) and MT (infrastructure/IT). Samir (copied) is our VP of Infrastructure and will want to cover network/ingress and data isolation. I’m adding security@ so they can weigh in on compliance scope (SOC2, logging, retention).

We can do Tue Dec 1 but prefer the later PT slot to align with our East Coast folks: Tue Dec 1, 14:00–15:00 PT (that’s 17:00–18:00 ET). Can Karthik cover port/egress questions and will SE confirm if VPN/personal device requirements are needed?

Also attaching our high-level network sketch and a short SOC2 questionnaire — we’ll need answers before any private deployment conversation.

Best,
Aliyah Thompson
Head of Clinical Ops, Solstice Health
aliyah@solsticehealth.com

Attachments: network-topology-sketch.png; SOC2-scoping-questions.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aliyah Thompson <aliyah@solsticehealth.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_l@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro + technical demo for Solstice Health

Aliyah — thanks for the context and the attachments. 14:00 PT on Dec 1 works on my side. Quick technical notes to prepare your IT/security:  

- For a hosted Redwood deployment we typically require outbound TLS (443) to our dedicated endpoints and allowlist the IP ranges we’ll provide for ingestion.
- If you prefer a Private/VPC deployment we’ll need a short window to walk through VPN or peering options — that’s where Marcus and I will discuss procurement and latency expectations.
- I’ll bring a one-slide network map example and a checklist for SOC2 evidence mapping to the demo.

Can security@ confirm whether they need any specific scans or documentation pre-demo? If helpful, I can run a 15-minute pre-call with Samir to review the network sketch.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[karthik_iyer@redwood.ai]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Aliyah Thompson <aliyah@solsticehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_l@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + technical demo for Solstice Health

Looping in Priyom (Customer Success) so we can set the mutual action plan and next steps after the demo. Confirming we’ll run Tue Dec 1, 14:00–15:00 PT / 17:00–18:00 ET. Agenda proposal:

1) 5 min intro + goals (Aliyah)
2) 20 min technical demo (Karthik) — focus on inference latency, multi-tenant isolation, and deployment options
3) 10 min security/compliance Q&A (Samir + security@)
4) 10 min procurement & next steps (Marcus + Priyom)

Pre-demo requests for security team: please review SOC2-scoping-questions.xlsx and network-topology-sketch.png. If you can flag any blockers (ports, scans, or certs) before the call we’ll adjust the demo accordingly. We’ll also share a brief doc that maps our runtime isolation guarantees to SOC2 control categories.

See you on the 1st. Marcus

Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0182
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@solsticehealth.com>

Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro + technical demo for Solstice Health

Thanks everyone — confirming the 14:00 PT slot is fine. A couple of requests ahead of the demo:  

- Please provide the IP ranges you’ll use for outbound connections and whether those differ between Hosted vs Private options.
- Include a short list of expected logs (audit, access, retention) and how we can export them to our SIEM.
- If you support mutual TLS for private peering, include the steps and cert requirements.

If you can drop those items into the HubSpot record or share a short doc before the call that would be great. Otherwise we’ll take notes and follow up. Looking forward to the demo.

—Samir
VP Infrastructure, Solstice Health
samir.patel@solsticehealth.com
